<script>
    (function () {
      "use strict";

      var STORAGE_KEY = "todos.v1";
      var listEl = document.getElementById("todo-list");
      var inputEl = document.getElementById("new-todo");
      var addBtn = document.getElementById("add-btn");
      var statsEl = document.getElementById("stats");
      var emptyEl = document.getElementById("empty-hint");
      var filterBtns = Array.prototype.slice.call(
        document.querySelectorAll(".filters button")
      );

      var todos = load();
      var currentFilter = "all";

      function load() {
        try {
          var raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
          if (!raw) return [];
          var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) return [];
          return parsed.filter(function (t) {
            return t && typeof t.id === "number" &&
                   typeof t.text === "string" &&
                   typeof t.done === "boolean";
          });
        } catch (e) {
          return [];
        }
      }

      function save() {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(todos));
        } catch (e) {
          /* 存储满或不可用时静默失败 */
        }
      }

      function addTodo(text) {
        var trimmed = text.trim();
        if (!trimmed) return;
        todos.push({
          id: Date.now(),
          text: trimmed,
          done: false
        });
        save();
        render();
      }

      function toggleTodo(id) {
        todos.forEach(function (t) {
          if (t.id === id) t.done = !t.done;
        });
        save();
        render();
      }

      function removeTodo(id) {
        todos = todos.filter(function (t) { return t.id !== id; });
        save();
        render();
      }
